description: This file contains a report implementation for supplier quotation comparison in ERPNext, including data retrieval, processing, and chart preparation functions.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches supplier quotation data from the database based on filters and conditions.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares and formats data for report display and chart visualization.

methods.name: prepare_chart_data
methods.description: Generates chart data for supplier and quantity comparison.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines report columns based on filters.

methods.name: get_message
methods.description: Returns a status message regarding quotation validity.
